shared_construction_contract.proposal_core: ProviderProposalCoreV1 serialized through the R2R recovery main schema V2 for provider arms
shared_construction_contract.proposal_envelope: RuleProposalEnvelopeV1 added by project code after provider parsing
shared_construction_contract.main_prompt_scope: one bounded delayed-response proposal using only ConstructionInputViewV1; exact relation, directions, horizon, approved references, window references, and runtime-logic family

t0.mechanism: The authorized real adapter deterministically copies the frozen relation identity, source/target and directions, selected horizon, ten approved numeric/window reference identities, variables, and fixed runtime-logic family into ProviderProposalCoreV1, then invokes the deterministic validity layer.
t0.numeric_literals: prohibited; approved E1 reference identities are copied
t0.failure_behavior: verifier rejection becomes construction outcome no_rule with reason t0_verifier_rejection
t0.meaning_of_42_42: 42 of 42 scheduled relations ended with an accepted_proposal after deterministic validity admission; it is not a detection result and did not itself grant runtime authority.

reproducibility.basis: zero provider calls, fixed template mapping, frozen template hash, approved-reference copying, deterministic verifier
reproducibility.caveat: E2's helper named generate_synthetic_t0_core_v1 was synthetic-locked; real execution used the separate authorized run_real_t0_v1 adapter. These must not be conflated.

t1.mechanism: Render the frozen evidence view once, send one strict structured-output request, parse one ProviderProposalCoreV1, wrap it with project-owned provenance, then invoke deterministic validity once. No verifier feedback or second scientific generation is allowed.

failure_behavior.parse_or_nonproposal: no_rule with scientific_response:<parse_status>; verifier is not invoked

t1.meaning_of_42_42: 42 of 42 relation-level outcomes were accepted_proposal: each response parsed and its proposal was verifier-admissible. This does not mean 42 runtime-authorized rules or 42 detected attacks.

reproducibility.nondeterminism: temperature 0.7 with null seed; seed determinism explicitly not claimed

t1b.mechanism: Send three stateless, feedback-free calls with the same rendered initial request and model configuration. Parse and independently verify each available proposal. Select the lowest admissible call index after all three calls; if none is admissible, return no_rule.

independence_contract.interpretation: Independent means isolated stateless draws with no cross-call information, not seeded repeatability or a proof of statistical independence.

frozen_outcome.one_parse_failure_handling: call consumed without fabricating a proposal or invoking verifier; the relation remained accepted through its admissible call 1 proposal

t1b.meaning_of_42_42: All 42 relations had at least one admissible proposal among the three draws and therefore a selected accepted_proposal relation outcome. It does not mean all 126 responses parsed or were admissible: 125 parsed, 122 were admissible, 3 were rejected, and 1 failed schema parsing.

reproducibility.basis: same immutable request/model configuration and full call/response/proposal/validity custody
reproducibility.nondeterminism: temperature 0.7, null seed, no seed-determinism claim

t1b_vs_t2_fairness.contract_level: Both have the same precommitted maximum of three scientific generation calls per relation, the same first-call evidence/prompt/model view, and no result-dependent budget extension. T1-B is the feedback-free repeated-generation comparator.
t1b_vs_t2_fairness.structural_difference: T1-B always spends all three calls and selects earliest admissible; T2 may stop early after deterministic accept or no_rule and may use later calls only through its bounded feedback/retrieval treatment.
t1b_vs_t2_fairness.realized_run: T1-B spent 126 calls; T2 spent 42 because every T2 relation terminated after call 1. No T2 feedback-eligible rejection occurred.
t1b_vs_t2_fairness.scientific_interpretation: The frozen realized comparison is best-of-three sampling versus one draw plus deterministic abstention. It does not identify a verifier-feedback effect; yield-versus-call-cost alone is explicitly incomparable without a declared trade-off metric.

lifecycle_separation.PORTFOLIO_FROZEN: A later exact executable-signature audit froze T0/T1/T1-B as one shared COMMON-42 projection; the construction-stage 42/42 outcome is not itself that portfolio freeze.
lifecycle_separation.RUNTIME_AUTHORIZED: False at construction. task039e0_validity_v2 explicitly does not auto-grant runtime authority. Later D1 runtime authority is a separate governance layer, not an automatic property of accepted proposals.

supported: A deterministic template baseline was implemented and yielded verifier-admissible proposals for all 42 frozen relations.
The one-shot constrained construction path yielded one parsed verifier-admissible proposal for each frozen relation in this cohort.
The feedback-free repeat path executed three isolated draws per relation and selected an admissible proposal for all 42 relations.
Project-owned deterministic validity, not the provider response, determined accepted_proposal versus no_rule.
pilot_only_or_partial: Repeated sampling recovered one relation only on call 3 after the first draw was not admissible; this is limited construction-validity evidence.
not_supported: LLM construction is superior to the deterministic template.
T1-B is more scientifically useful than T1 or T2.
Verifier acceptance automatically grants runtime authority.
The provider outputs are exactly reproducible by rerunning the model.

key_risks_and_unknowns.finding: Human-facing 42/42 wording can collapse relation-level accepted_proposal, proposal-level parsing/admissibility, later COMMON-42 portfolio freeze, and runtime authorization into one misleading state.
key_risks_and_unknowns.required_wording: Report 42/42 as relation-level verifier-admitted construction outcomes only.

key_risks_and_unknowns.finding: T1-B and T2 share maximum budget and first-call input but fixed three-call sampling versus adaptive early stop means realized call cost and treatment exposure differ.
key_risks_and_unknowns.required_wording: FAIR_BY_CONTRACT for the precommitted construction comparison; current realized run is not a feedback-effect test.

key_risks_and_unknowns.finding: Provider construction is custody-reproducible but not bitwise generation-reproducible because seed is null and temperature is nonzero.
key_risks_and_unknowns.required_wording: Do not call T1/T1-B deterministic or independently reproduced by generation replay.

key_risks_and_unknowns.finding: The generic helper name generate_synthetic_t0_core_v1 can obscure that real execution used run_real_t0_v1.
key_risks_and_unknowns.required_wording: Name the real adapter explicitly in architecture documentation.
